notes.title: "Full Info" mode
notes.content:
[list]
[*] new "full-info" mode: face-down cards are drawn face-up but tinted + stack tooltips list all cards (face-up or down). 30% penalty on the victory reward. With no randomness, hopefully it will play more puzzle-like
[*] on touchscreens, you can now press the "i" button at the top of the screen and then tap on a stack to see its tooltip
[*] "winnable only" penalty 50%->40%
[*] penalty %s now multiply instead of adding, for a less drastic final effect. E.g. if you play with "winnable only", "full info" and "iron man", the resulting multiplier is 0.6 * 0.7 * 2 = 0.84
[*] fix: graceful handling of video/GIF card sets with incorrectly sized thumbnail atlases (happens when you download from Discord using a web browser)
[/list]

notes.title: SFW version is out!
notes.content:
After frequent player requests, the free SFW version:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330280/Free_Solitaire/

Differences:
[list]
[*] SFW title and icon
[*] all adult content removed
[*] puzzles removed
[*] sex-themed variants removed, so it's only about 120 of them there
[/list]
You can still create card sets with the in-built editor and customize everything.

Since it's a different and technically unrelated app on Steam, your progress and achievements here won't be transferred to that app.

Max achievement still requires you to win 100 variants. There are fewer than 20 in total that have "very low" chance of winning. So, just skip those and you should be fine to 100% with a reasonable effort. 

I'm not sure if achievements there will show on your Steam profile and elsewhere, as, AFAIK, Steam doesn't show them in some places if the app is completely free. I'm not sure if DLCs influence that.

Each app uses separate custom content folders. So, if you created card sets here and want to use them in the SFW app, you'll need to manually copy the files between the folders. To browse to those folders, in [i]Options->Advanced[/i] scroll to the very bottom for the buttons [i]Your card sets[/i] and the like.

I have a kind request: if you review that app, please don't mention this NSFW version. I expect kids and moms to play that game, so it's best they don't see references to inappropriate material. Even if their Steam settings wouldn't allow them to open this NSFW game listing. Even if you, like  myself, think that NSFW is the best and who on Earth would need SFW anyways :) 

That's also why I used dev name WMGames instead my adult-sounding wittyminx there. May the porn stay completely separate to keep everyone happy.

Thank you for your understanding! 

About monetization: that app is free and will be free. I didn't expect to monetize it and have no clear plan for it. I'm simply trying to fulfil a popular request to accommodate for players in various situations. I might add paid DLCs (e.g. some big SFW card sets packs) if there is enough interest in that game. 

Thank you for your support and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Square cards
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added support for square cards. I personally like them the most. The cards themselves are 512x512, that's almost twice bigger than either a horizontal or vertical card (298x410). So, if you have high-quality photos, you will get them less shrunk in the game if you create a custom set with square frames in the editor
[*] some new card sets, backs and board element sets for horizontal and square cards - more will be coming in later updates
[*] in puzzles, there is now a button to quickly unlock many images, even if you don't see them because you disabled AI-generated content. This is intended for people who need all of the achievements but don't want to see any AI images or just don't want any puzzles at all
[*] checkbox in Advanced option to only randomize gfx when you start a new game, not restart the current one
[/list]

notes.title: Horizontal cards
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added support for horizontal cards. These are intended for videos or for pictures that come in landscape orientation (photos of nature, cars or sex scenes where characters are lying or on all fours)
[*] UI tweaks for better responsiveness. You should now see progress dialogs in most cases when a lot of external files are being loaded or processed. Even if you put a thousand images in the custom backgrounds folder, it will be handled
[*] card set viewer ("magnifying glass" icon the top-left corner) now has zoom controls (similar to those in the cards editor)
[*] card set editor can now save current editing project as a *.cprj file, and then load the project from that file. Technically it's just a zip archive with all your source files + card transformations data
[*] card set editor can now import video or GIF card sets for editing. So e.g. if you don't like just 2-3 videos in an otherwise okay set, you can load the set and edit/replace only those. Note: image card sets cannot be imported like that because source image data is lost when a card atlas is generated. You can still ask the card set's author for the cprj project file (if they have saved the project)
[*] with horizontal cards, most solitaire variants use other board layouts. As I was designing those layouts, I tweaked some of the old ones for vertical cards. The purpose was to make the cards look as big as possible - since I suppose the sexy stuff on the cards is why this game exists in the first place :)
[/list]

[*] added buttons to download soundtracks for the game. These mostly lead to Envato Elements pages where you can buy a subscription (from Envato), download previews or just play them online. I licensed them from Envato so I can't sell them here as soundtrack

[*] Auld Lang Syne finally has the first winnable seed! Congrats to the person who won it :) Now it's only Tam O'Shanter remaining...
[/list]
